title: RDTII Hand-off #1 Manifest Row
description: One row per retrieved document. Authored verbatim from INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md §2.2 (24 fields, 15 required). This JSON Schema — not the PLAN.md prose restatement — is the single source of truth for the field set. Validates both manifest.csv rows (after type coercion) and manifest.jsonl rows (which additionally carry a nested `http` object).

contract_version.description: SemVer seam/schema version; MAJOR-gated by P2/P3.

doc_id.description: Stable join key <cc>-<lawslug>-<seq>, e.g. sg-pdpa2012-001. Widened from the three Round 1 economies so Timor-Leste and Lao PDR validate (CONTRACT.md 0.3.0).

economy.description: Two-letter code, equal to the economy's registry code. Widened from the enum [SG, AU, MY], which rejected every Timorese and Lao row (CONTRACT.md 0.3.0).

source_url.description: Exact URL the bytes came from; must resolve at judging time.

access_date.description: ISO-8601 UTC retrieval time, trailing Z required.

pdf_is_scanned.description: Required present in every row; null ONLY when source_type=html (enforced below).

local_path.description: Path under handoff1/, RELATIVE (no absolute/drive-letter paths — portability contract rule).

indicator_hints.description: Comma-list of in-scope indicator IDs, e.g. 'P7-I2'.

anchor_hint.description: Whole portal-specific deep-link suffix incl. leading ?/#.

publication_date.description: Date the law was published/gazetted, as shown on the portal (raw portal format).

assent_date.description: Royal assent / making date (MY 'Royal Assent Date', AU register makingDate).

commencement_date.description: Commencement date or remark, as shown on the portal (may be a multi-jurisdiction remark).

http.description: manifest.jsonl only: nested {status, redirect_chain[], headers{}} too bulky for CSV.
